decisions.diagnosis: zero_outage removed real zeros during the March 2021 flood rains; the counter kept recording and the neighbouring counters were equally near-empty.
decisions.evidence: 202 raw 35/0/4 on 19-21 Mar vs site 200 (43/2/11) and site 201 (20/3/9) at the same junction; low but non-zero counts on 18, 22, 23 Mar at all three counters.

decisions.diagnosis: zero_outage removed zeros during the early-July 2022 flood rains; every counter at the junction was near zero from 1 to 6 July, so the zeros are real.
decisions.evidence: 202 raw 2/0/5 on 2-4 Jul; sites 200 and 201 also 1/0/4 and 0/0/2; 1 and 5-6 Jul (unfixed) only 4-15 per day at 202.

decisions.diagnosis: Partial-day zero_outage on a wet Saturday; the other direction and neighbours were just as low.
decisions.evidence: 233 raw 5, 244 raw 4 (unfixed), sites 200/201 directions 4-6 each vs about 30-50 on the surrounding days.

decisions.diagnosis: zero_outage on one direction on a low (wet) day that all counters share; the zeros are real.
decisions.evidence: 22 Jun 233 raw 2, 244 raw 3 (unfixed), sites 200/201 directions 5-7 each; 21 Jun is a normal 36.

decisions.diagnosis: zero_outage on one direction during a wet weekend when every counter at the junction was low.
decisions.evidence: 244 raw 2/13, 233 raw 3/9 (unfixed); sites 200/201 directions 2-3 on 2 Aug and 5-16 on 3 Aug.

summary: Site 202 has a single piezo counter (182) with two directions, one record per slot, and a steady record from March 2021 to September 2026; the direction split (about 0.53 NW) and the ratio to the co-located sites 200/201 barely change. The only automatic fixes are zero_outage runs. Most fall on heavy-rain days when the neighbouring counters were equally near-empty, so they are restored. The all-counter full-day zero on 2025-10-20, between two normal days with a clean midnight-to-midnight cut, is a real outage and stays missing.
